text: This report provides information on the collaboration with Heritage Toronto to celebrate the history of women's sport at Exhibition Place.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Requested the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place to bring requests to lease holders at Coca-Cola Coliseum and BMO Field to improve the sports team experience including washrooms, placement of team specific logos, displaying memorabilia and other enhancements, and consider these factors in any lease negotiations to better recognize women’s sports in Toronto and at Exhibition Place.
